newsitem.title: GERMANY: German passenger traffic grows 6.1pct in May 97.
newsitem.headline: German passenger traffic grows 6.1pct in May 97.

text.p: German air traffic grew 6.1 percent in May to more than 10.6 million passengers, the German airports association ADV said.
The passenger market grew 4.8 percent to nearly 45 million travellers over the first five months of 1997, the latest ADV traffic report showed.
Domestic air travel slowed after a strong April pick-up but intercontinental travel showed double-figure growth for the second successive month.
The fastest-growing major airports last month were Munich, Duesseldorf and Hanover, the report showed.
